summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-21 ~ 2026-11-23）

- ⚡ arm64 引入 HVO，调整 pgalloc/pgtable 与 CPU capability 探测，显著降低大页 vmemmap 内存占用（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- 🔧 PCI 新增 pci_power_t 辅助函数替换分散的电源状态字面值，x86 early-quirks 一并改用（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- 🔥 userland 容器提案推进至 v7，新增跨架构系统调用号与 UAPI 文档，为 fd 绑定的进程隔离铺路（[Scheduling](#subsystem-Scheduling)）
- ⚡ arm64 NEON crc64_nvme 支持非整块数据，小尾块不再回退标量实现（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）
- ⚡ xswap 第一阶段改写 swap 设备管理、page_io、zswap 与 vmalloc 路径，提升多 swap 设备扩展性（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）
- 🐛 TCP 固定 ID 标志改为跟随所描述的头部，修正隧道/封装路径下 GSO 分段标志错位（[Networking](#subsystem-Networking)）

## Architecture
- PCI 新增 pci_power_t 辅助函数，替换分散的电源状态字面值，x86 early-quirks 与 quirk 代码一并改用。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121130936.53191-2-habilerenturker@hotmail.com/)
- 上述 pci_power_t 辅助函数系列的 v3 版本，清理 PCI 电源状态判断的魔法值用法。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121125811.50315-1-habilerenturker@hotmail.com/)
- `perf` arm64 引入 HugeTLB vmemmap 优化（HVO），调整 pgalloc/pgtable 与 CPU capability 探测，显著降低大页 vmemmap 内存占用。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122184453.2668189-1-jthoughton@google.com/)
- `perf` 为 Apple M3 系列添加 CPU 调频与 OPP 表，启用 cluster cpufreq（v2）。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-m3-cpufreq-opp-v2-0-3c19963f55ee@gmail.com/)
- `perf` 上述 M3 调频与 OPP 支持的 v1 版本。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-m3-cpufreq-opp-v1-0-42a0c07c48a4@gmail.com/)
- `perf` rkvdec 增加 VDPU346 变体支持，扩展 RK356x 上 H.264/HEVC 硬件解码覆盖。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795279680.git.daniel@makrotopia.org/)
- `perf` 为 Amlogic T7 添加以太网支持，含 MDIO mux 绑定与 Khadas VIM4 板级 dts。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121213102.143130-1-tanure@linux.com/)
- `perf` 描述 kaanapali 的 UFS MCQ 寄存器，打通多队列 UFS 访问路径。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121164453.26-1-26rote@gmail.com/)
- 增加 Qualcomm Molokai（SM8845）与 Motorola Signature 平台支持，含 socinfo/PD mapper 更新。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-molokai-soc-v4-0-851e5a9f4878@yahoo.com/)
- 新增 Rockchip IEP2 去隔行驱动，支持 RK3568/RK3588 视频后处理。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-iep2-v4-0-760cf25f322b@gmail.com/)
- 另有 57 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-meson-drm-create-hdmitx-phy-v3-0-f8f471788076@aliel.fr/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122184337.6551-1-mstoretv@cern.ch/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-pcie6_fix-v2-0-2e0fe615d90b@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-camss-sdm845-icc-v1-0-0671ef770fd0@enser.io/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121090146.39170-1-henri@ommer.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121082404.24864-1-henri@ommer.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-t8122-smc-dt-v1-0-898f3f5d6228@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-sp11-x1p-10core-v1-1-5fed8ce846c7@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121105320.478279-1-zhang_wei@open-hieco.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-fajita-battery-energy-v1-1-ce6f0d69947e@enser.io/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-axolotl-misc-v1-1-27211eded948@ixit.cz/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121110806.1158344-1-zhanghongtao35@huawei.com/) 等 57 项

## Scheduling
- `perf` 新增 userland 容器系统调用与 UAPI，覆盖多个架构的 syscall 表，为绑定文件描述符的进程隔离提供基础。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122193539.3334213-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- `perf` userland 容器 v6 系列补全 UAPI 文档与多架构系统调用号，继续推进容器隔离接口。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122011809.2667684-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- rootns v5：绑定文件描述符的进程闭包，新增文档与 syscall 表，探索根命名空间隔离。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121000844.1863324-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` sched_ext 补齐 dl_server 对 RT 饥饿保护的两处缺口，降低 RT 任务被延迟的风险。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-scx-dlsrv-v1-0-87c342d8246e@gmail.com/)
- sched/fair 削减调度域重建中的逐组计算，改为复用已有状态，降低 CPU 热插拔路径开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-bug-sched-fair-offline-active-v3-0-325e9eefa56d@linux.dev/)
- sched/proxy 与 sched_ext：当 SCX owner 持有 holding_cpu 时跳过 proxy-exec，避免错误代理。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122035254.2891197-1-penghuang@google.com/)
- sched_ext 在 set_next_task_scx 中更新 other_load_avgs，使负载估计更及时准确。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122033316.2819845-1-penghuang@google.com/)
- sched/fair 注释补上缺失的右括号，仅文档性修正。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121114129.1443346-2-manuelebnerli@mailbox.org/)
- `bugfix` 修复非原子 static key 启用时 uclamp 的竞态，避免调度类切换期间参数失效。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121041507.39582-1-qyousef@layalina.io/)
- `bugfix` sched_ext 在 rt_mutex_setprio 切换到 SCX 时阻断 donor，避免优先级反转路径失效。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122042605.2996910-1-penghuang@google.com/)
- 另有 4 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121031329.240177-1-longman@redhat.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122121823.2572209-1-albin_yang@163.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/awLLjKQ1IUKuQ3eb@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122015729.2512645-1-penghuang@google.com/)

## Filesystem & Storage
- `perf` `bugfix` VFS 修复集更新 bdev 及 powerpc/sparc/um/xtensa 等 proc 接口，收敛 7.4-rc 回归。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-vfs-7.4-rc4.fixes-0bcebc1aae75@brauner/)
- `perf` scsi bsg 借助 io_uring 在 end-I/O 阶段释放请求，缩短完成路径上的等待与回拷开销。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/scsi-pool-v5.1795249365940711260.0.x-professor@outlook.com/)
- exfat 新增 EXFAT_IOC_COMBINE ioctl，可将一个文件的簇区间追加到另一文件，为跨文件数据合并提供免拷贝路径。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122124029.609636-1-shaopei_1012@163.com/)
- `perf` `other` blk-mq 在 hctx cpumask 为空时把 dispatch kworker 投到 housekeeping CPU，避免调度落到无效 CPU。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121235203.811792-1-atomlin@atomlin.com/)
- erofs 校验 fsoffset 对齐并限制页读取范围，防止元数据越界读。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-01-erofs-fsoffset-oob-v2-9c629f3ad714-v2-1-2cfb14e36120@pm.me/)
- fileattr 为 API 增加 xflags 读写掩码，让各文件系统按权限限制扩展属性的可写位。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122000856.536902-1-koray.fra@gmail.com/)
- ceph 跨客户端串行化 O_APPEND 写入，避免多客户端并发追加造成文件大小不一致。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-ceph-append-excl-v1-0-5870375edeb8@clyso.com/)
- `bugfix` ocfs2 在拆除 journal 前等待 fs_state 读者退出，避免释放后使用。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-ocfs2-objects-candidate-0003-v8-8fb510a5c52b337960c9@gmail.com/)
- xfs 增加每文件系统 sysfs 开关，可强制对写操作使用原子 CoW。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/LV0PR10MB997684D5CA8A6AC037F6D1CD8AB9472@LV0PR10MB997684.namprd10.prod.outlook.com/)
- fuse 在没有等待者的场景下不再等待 sync-init 挂载完成，加快挂载返回。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122152514.467423-1-7z0423arsenova@proton.me/)
- 另有 30 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122130247.2069007-1-hengyul@cs.unc.edu/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121030951.1470502-1-fredric.cover.lkernel@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121132519.2182511-1-teel4res@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121182313.43201-1-dennylin0707@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121042743.1139584-1-csander@purestorage.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122013704.TwrYBZ2CkxNIMlJiQqFfn8e5z3VWu__Wkjeqxwa04rk@z/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-zram-split-decomp-mm-rfc-v1-0-4e69b08c0fed@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/bada6649ca5eb9e4603216c71aff0a85@manguebit.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122224829803Cnc907ditjVjp2YzW1gmE@zte.com.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122034826.2333981-1-mc@raidlab.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122045841.99012-1-fredric.cover.lkernel@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121205657.1108500-1-mc@raidlab.org/) 等 30 项

## Observability
- `perf` udmabuf 加速大页后备缓冲区的 mmap，减少映射开销。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-feat-udmabuf-huge-pfnmap-v1-0-dcba888940c2@linux.dev/)
- `perf` 采用内核 compiler-context-analysis 注解，改善编译器优化与构建效率。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121065813.4143649-1-irogers@google.com/)
- ALSA seq UMP 为 MIDI 1.0 客户端转换 MIDI 2.0 RPN/NRPN，提升跨版本兼容。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122103611.3264343-1-sammiee5311@gmail.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` tracing 合入 v7.4 修复，覆盖 ring buffer、事件过滤与用户事件等路径。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121075739.3ad033bf@fedora/)
- `perf` 新增 Intel PMT 命令行工具，导出 x86 平台遥测数据，便于功耗与性能观测。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795374925.git.david.e.box@linux.intel.com/)
- `perf` `other` 符号表改为有序数组并由 DSO 管理生命周期，降低内存占用并加速查找。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122050405.80335-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `other` 符号表有序数组与 DSO 生命周期改造的 v7 版本，功能与 v8 基本一致。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121071651.67118-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `other` script 延迟加载符号，减少大符号表场景的启动内存与解析开销。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-perf-symbol-memory-send-v8-0-370561cbb5a7@uber.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 增加覆盖测试框架并修复其发现的路径，提升 perf 子命令可测性。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121032052.1392234-1-acme@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` Landlock 修复审计与访问控制问题，并补充 trace 事件文档。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121195404.2775730-1-mic@digikod.net/)
- 另有 20 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795262546.git.chaosheng.qu.linux@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122123427.287521-1-abhishekkhade69@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-perf-dso-ns-fix-v1-1-897322ddadf8@uber.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121003403.2928928-1-ihor.solodrai@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122143815.330528-1-abhishekkhade69@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122155620.319722-1-bestswngs@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795307698.git.edumucelli@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122103838.244974-1-abhishekkhade69@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795258353.git.chaosheng.qu.linux@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121182217.4609-1-emmaonana18@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122031025.9771-1-fadouse@pm.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122122525.71959-1-ojeda@kernel.org/) 等 20 项

## Drivers
- regmap 重构 __regmap_init 及 i2c/spi 注册路径，简化初始化并补充 kunit 覆盖 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-regmap-improve-2nd-v1-0-6b5fd59451ed@nxp.com/)
- drm HDMI helper 新增 colorspace 属性，并接入 dw-hdmi-qp 与 rockchip 输出链路 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121160725.6344-1-jan.claussen10@web.de/)
- colorspace 支持第 5 版，drm 连接器与 HDMI helper 暴露色彩空间属性 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121131126.3358-1-jan.claussen10@web.de/)
- drm bridge/panel 支持状态读回，使 i.MX8MN 显示链路可继承已有硬件状态 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122153032.2782768-1-dario.binacchi@amarulasolutions.com/)
- 新增 drm_mipi_dbi_bus 抽象与 Tegra20/30 8-bit CPU 接口，附两款面板驱动 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122081820.53199-1-clamor95@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` 修正 __drm_debug 段属性、类型收窄及 dyndbg 构建问题，降低调试开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-rd-mostly-v3-0-89e74b23b491@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` Input 子系统更新，修复 ff-core、input 核心及多个鼠标/摇杆驱动问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/awJX_vVgR79DxVuw@google.com/)
- `bugfix` SPI 核心与 fsl-lpspi 修复，处理 v7.4-rc3 回归 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121123038.535713464378@traversing.sirena.org.uk/)
- `bugfix` 修正 gpio get 快路径位图长度不足，避免越界访问 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/nh-fc54eb6a-a671-409c-bf5d-51ad5828438e@google.com/)
- `bugfix` drm/ttm 对超大页目录分配不再告警，避免正常路径误报（v2） [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121095703.1571697-2-shuicheng.lin@intel.com/)
- 另有 77 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121091815.1436090-2-shuicheng.lin@intel.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-cs75xx-v9-0-1fc1b90bd097@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-cs75xx-v8-0-5f971b0dc69c@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-at550-rfc-v1-v2-0-b0309d0789b2@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/awE7o4z1DMGb-YMg@debian.cy/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122021849.57863-1-denis.benato@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/tencent_F495CC22423581B98A12990F93C04F33CB06@qq.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/tencent_6F7C9E04169BCBAE4E162DAA3DCD5395B209@qq.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-tle493d-v2-0-92d7e57cec89@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-vantage-panel-v4-0-e9c2f15b318d@yahoo.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-serial-tegra-baud-tolerance-v1-1-39907382281f@enser.io/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-lt9611usc_edid34_misc_next-v5-1-00b562fe4a24@oss.qualcomm.com/) 等 77 项

## Power Management
- Qualcomm VBUS 补丁：新增 PMI8998/PM660 VBUS 稳压器与 smb2 充电驱动联动，多款 SDM845/670 设备树启用对外供电 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-pmi8998-vbus-v3-0-91ba2e61a877@ixit.cz/)
- `perf` `other` smb347 依据 APSD 检测结果设置 USB 输入电流限值，使充电电流与外设供电能力匹配 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-upstream-smb347-apsd-v1-0-ca46b92bfd44@tsv-stahl-riesa.de/)
- qcom socinfo 移除带 ID 的 DT 绑定，clk 与 cpufreq nvmem 改用新接口，避免绑定被滥用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-qcom-socinfo-id-dt-bindings-v1-0-eeee0ffa25da@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- 另有 9 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-vantage-battmgr-v2-0-03a419078d0a@yahoo.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-tegra-soctherm-shifted-cp-v1-1-528e3621226c@enser.io/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/tencent_5995CC7B942E7CD204E49AE7AE32164BAB09@qq.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-smbx-ccv-v1-1-0ecc4217b58c@enser.io/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121113605.jDNtw%25mhudan21@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121204137.848173-1-mick@yoxcu.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121122938.B669F346436F@traversing.sirena.org.uk/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-cpufreq-leaks-v1-0-96fc17ff7339@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-tps65910-shutdown-ext-control-v1-1-e86b284e8c6c@proton.me/)

## Clocks & Timers
- Airoha AN7583 时钟驱动新增 SCU 支持，含 DT binding 与 reset 头文件，扩展该 SoC 平台的时钟与复位控制能力 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121212738.170775-1-ansuelsmth@gmail.com/)
- 新增 gpio-enabled clock 驱动与 binding，可用 GPIO 门控外部时钟，v11 为当前版本 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-feature-clock-guard-v11-0-00c633a667a2@bruker.com/)
- gpio-enabled clock 驱动 v10 版本，与 v11 同一提案的早期修订 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-feature-clock-guard-v10-0-5d449739bb8c@bruker.com/)
- `bugfix` RP1 时钟 provider 探测失败后可重新探测，避免一次失败后永久不可用，v2 修订版 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121181650.143474-1-joshuacov@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` RP1 时钟 provider 允许再次探测，修复探测失败后无法恢复的问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121163915.86681-1-joshuacov@gmail.com/)
- Rockchip RK3506 增加 SAI MCLK 输出门控时钟，补齐音频主时钟输出通路 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/tencent_DFDA05189A0FAFA816FFAB91CC2F95247C09@qq.com/)
- Sopho SG2042 clkgen 保留固件占用的 gate 时钟常开，避免运行时被误关断导致异常 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-sg2042-efi-rtc-v2-0-6d087e03e4e8@iscas.ac.cn/)
- 另有 2 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122024001.375239-1-admin@mswin.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-rzg2l-coupled-clk-v1-1-c38c8299c176@gmail.com/)

## Memory
- `perf` 引入可扩展 swap 设备（xswap 第一阶段，14 个补丁），改写 swap 设备管理、page_io、zswap 与 vmalloc 路径，提升多 swap 设备的扩展性 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122123918.3486916-1-baoquan.he@linux.dev/)
- `perf` 新增 page_alloc_kunit 合成基准，为页面分配器提供可复现的吞吐与延迟测量手段 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/c872d827-76c8-f765-0634-c84c7d9ce853@google.com/)
- `perf` 新增 slab_kunit 合成基准，用于量化 slab 分配器在不同负载下的性能表现 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/ae9aa46f-8b6d-6c10-ab8d-aff30ebbe338@google.com/)
- `perf` 补齐 KUnit 页面分配器与 slab 基准的系列框架，将两项基准纳入统一测试套件 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/0cf294b9-0ce1-dc6f-7cac-b589c9060271@google.com/)
- `other` memcg 引入 effective high limit，避免因高水位限制触发内存隔离问题，涉及 filemap、shmem、khugepaged 等多条路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122024737.2741569-1-shakeel.butt@linux.dev/)
- `other` hugetlb 在早期分配阶段优先使用较大的 CMA 页，减少碎片与后续分配失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122065527.33123-1-qi.zheng@linux.dev/)
- `other` memcg OOM 扫描不再漏掉 leader 已退出的进程，避免 OOM 选错目标 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121073222.834282-1-zhanxusheng1024@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` 修复迁移与 inode 回收路径下 folio 锁死锁，涉及 huge_memory 与 migrate [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-migrate_reclaim_deadlock-v1-0-83c56185b0fb@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` DAMON 在 damos_commit 中不再覆盖 wmarks.activated，保留已激活状态 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122002930.98401-1-evanfengff@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` 修复 DAMON 水位间隔为零时 damos_walk 挂起的问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121025626.75981-1-evanfengff@gmail.com/)

## Virtualization
- `perf` `bugfix` ：KVM irqfd 改为在加入首个成员之后再发布 resampler，避免并发路径读到未完成初始化的对象 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122095010.444794-1-shijing.wuqi@linux.alibaba.com/)
- 新增 virtio-media 驱动与配套 uapi 头，通过 virtio 向 guest 暴露媒体设备与 ioctl 接口 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121025007.3445723-1-briandaniels@google.com/)
- vhost 对 in-order used-ring 的日志游标做掩码，防止游标越界导致的日志写入越界 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-06-vhost-in-order-log-oob-v1-35efdba8fbab-v1-1-fc1253d60351@pm.me/)
- vhost/net 限定 VHOST_SET_FEATURES_ARRAY 的 count 上限，拒绝超长数组传入 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122120919.1718445-1-hengyul@cs.unc.edu/)

## Networking
- `perf` `bugfix` sch_cbs 传输时间估算的 32 位乘法溢出，避免错误门控与实际发送时刻偏差 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122064155.2094434-1-mhm.dawod@gmail.com/)
- smc 用本地缓冲区范围校验对端 CDC 游标，防止异常/恶意对端造成越界访问 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122042120.2430434-1-piyus@iiitd.ac.in/)
- `perf` `bugfix` au1000 以太网与 smsc PHY 一批修复，含 Kconfig 与收发路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121004809.1690280-1.f.fainelli@gmail.com/)
- TCP 固定 ID 标志改为跟随其描述的头部，修正隧道/封装路径下 GSO 分段标志错位，涉及 skbuff、BPF 与网卡驱动 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795284858.git.julius@bairaktaris.de/)
- printk/netconsole 引入不安全刷新策略，panic 与重启路径下控制台、netconsole 输出可按策略取舍 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121163557.963029-1-john.ogness@linutronix.de/)
- 迁移设备到其他 netns 时改用逐表同步替代全局 RCU 屏障，减少迁移耗时随规模增长 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-bug-net-netns-move-rcu-barrier-v5-0-100a3b5d9090@linux.dev/)
- mac80211 为封装卸载增加 TSO 与 scatter-gather，并修正 802.3 RX 帧的 TID 传递，ath11k/ath12k 获益 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122134228.956044-1-julius@bairaktaris.de/)
- mac80211 地址变更后重新添加接口失败时回滚，避免接口状态不一致 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121170346.12440-1-25031212351@stu.xidian.edu.cn/)
- Bluetooth hci_sync 将 destroy 回调移到锁外调用，避免持锁回调导致死锁 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121120121.576-1-viennaoffh@gmail.com/)
- `other` RFCOMM 在拆除与 TTY 交接期间保护 socket，避免并发释放 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0218-v8-da37c8a6b33c9d2d8efc-0@gmail.com/)
- 另有 56 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121065625.27934-1-18983559317@163.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0167-v9-45c99868af18e41665a3-0@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0132-v9-b93d60723e48169ee3ae-0@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0228-v10-f6ced931e2322aa5c7b3-0@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122131850.44042-1-26031212468@stu.xidian.edu.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-nfc-se-io-filter-v1-1-a28b383a6300@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-b4-02-act-ife-rtnl-uaf-v2-102eba468698-v2-1-67c413c45928@pm.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121103222.88209-1-jiayuan.chen@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121033104.441146-1-andreiab9019@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122150541.3117507-1-julius@bairaktaris.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122-reuseport-lock-filter-v1-1-a3e5324c8d55@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/179534083350.2499182.16169984227830330896@gmail.com/) 等 56 项

## Core Kernel
- `perf` arm64 NEON crc64_nvme 支持非整块数据，小尾块也能走向量路径，避免回退标量实现 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122082122.664360-1-16567adigashreesh@gmail.com/)
- `perf` core 在 perf_sched_events 关闭时跳过 cgroup attach 的 IPI，减少任务迁移路径上的中断开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-feat-perf-cgroup-attach-ipi-v1-1-a0e6d3cce8d1@linux.dev/)
- rcutorture 用吃 CPU 的读者重写 RCU 优先级提升测试，并新增内核参数与配置项，覆盖更真实的 boost 场景 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121153552.68941-1-jfern@kernel.org/)
- softirq 将 BH 计数告警限定在 RT 的 BH 锁用户，避免非 RT 场景误报刷屏 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/d9554bee441d2c763ef8d61e966a7a471915bbee.1795372382.git.cyyzero16@gmail.com/)
- `other` xarray 新根节点创建时初始化 offset 并在测试中覆盖，避免读到未定义偏移 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/08ceefcb212e4dda9767389fe7f162a8.0@linux-foundation.org/)
- `other` raid6 x86 AVX2/AVX512/SSE2 修正 xor_syndrome 汇编约束并加入 sfence、预取，提升多核校验计算正确性与吞吐 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122032933.2306875-1-mc@raidlab.org/)
- `bugfix` kobject 修复带 tag 的 uevent 广播中的释放后使用，避免并发广播时访问已释放对象 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122061751.178540-1-omermetekaya0@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` lib/crc 将新增 NEON crc64 折叠常量改为 uint64_t，消除 32 位平台上的常量截断 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261122152900.1113961-1-sashal@kernel.org/)

## Security
- `other` 将密钥实例化与 keyctl_chown_key 串行化，避免实例化期间属主被并发修改造成状态不一致 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121111246.3478-1-enscrpt@pm.me/)
- `bugfix` AppArmor 针对路径型套接字的 Unix 对端检查不再睡眠，避免在不可睡眠上下文触发睡眠错误 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-apparmor-unix-peer-v1-1-99dd1cdb1e27@gmail.com/)
- `other` KEYS 在 request_key 构造密钥时用 key 信号量保护 construct_key 的类型解引用，消除并发访问下的类型竞态 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121125039.2532663-1-tristmd@gmail.com/)
